# Coursera

> > Coursera is a global online learning platform offering courses, professional certificates, and degree programs from leading universities and tech companies like Google, IBM, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Stanford.

Coursera provides accessible education across multiple learning formats including individual courses, professional certificates, full degree programs, and enterprise solutions. The platform partners with top universities and technology companies to deliver training in high-demand fields like AI, data science, business, and cloud computing.

## Key Topics

- Professional Certificates
- Online Degrees
- Generative AI
- Data Science
- Machine Learning
- Google Career Certificates
- IBM Courses
- Microsoft Certifications
- Career Development
- Workforce Upskilling
- Cloud Computing
- Python Programming
- Business Skills
- Coursera Plus
- Online Learning Platform

## Learning Formats & Programs

- [Coursera Homepage](https://www.coursera.org): Main platform hub: online learning with courses, certificates, and degrees from Google, IBM, Microsoft, and universities.
- [Online Degrees](https://www.coursera.org/degrees): Full degree programs from universities including Illinois, Colorado Boulder, and Heriot-Watt.
- [Professional Certificates](https://www.coursera.org/google-career-certificates): Google professional certificates in UX design, project management, data analytics, and IT support.
- [Career Academy](https://www.coursera.org/career-academy): Explore job roles and build skills through career paths and professional certificates.

## Enterprise & Institutional Solutions

- [Coursera for Business](https://www.coursera.org/business): Enterprise learning solution for workforce upskilling and team development.
- [Coursera Campus](https://www.coursera.org/campus): Higher education platform for curriculum expansion and student employability.
- [Coursera for Government](https://www.coursera.org/government): E-learning platform for government workforce development and digital upskilling.

## AI & Technology Courses

- [Generative AI Courses](https://www.coursera.org/explore/generative-ai): 300+ generative AI and machine learning courses from industry leaders.
- [IBM Online Courses](https://www.coursera.org/explore/ibm-online-courses): IBM courses in AI, machine learning, data science, and cloud computing.
- [Microsoft Certificates](https://www.coursera.org/explore/microsoft-certificates): Microsoft 365, Excel, and Power BI data analysis training and certifications.
- [DeepLearning.AI Courses](https://www.coursera.org/explore/deep-learning-ai-online-courses): Deep learning, machine learning, and AI specializations by Andrew Ng.

## University & Partner Programs

- [Stanford University Courses](https://www.coursera.org/explore/stanford-online-courses): Machine learning, AI, business, and data science education from Stanford.
- [University of Illinois](https://www.coursera.org/partners/illinois): Master's degrees in computer science and business (iMBA) from University of Illinois.
- [University of Pennsylvania Courses](https://www.coursera.org/explore/university-of-pennsylvania-online-courses): Business, law, and psychology courses from University of Pennsylvania and Wharton.
- [University of Michigan Courses](https://www.coursera.org/explore/university-of-michigan-online-courses): Data science, healthcare, business, and Python programming from University of Michigan.

## AI & Emerging Technology Partnerships

- [OpenAI Courses](https://www.coursera.org/partners/openai): ChatGPT education and generative AI learning for professionals.
- [Anthropic Courses](https://www.coursera.org/partners/anthropic): Claude AI training and AI automation courses for learners.

## Skill Development & Discovery

- [Business Skills](https://www.coursera.org/explore/business-skills): Curated business courses in marketing, HR, finance, and career development with credentials.
- [Business Course Catalog](https://www.coursera.org/browse/business): Project management, marketing, leadership, and entrepreneurship courses.
- [Most Popular Courses](https://www.coursera.org/explore/most-popular-courses): Trending skills and certifications from top institutions.
